title: Jahrrechnungen der Stadt Basel 1535–1610 (Basel Records) — digital edition
institution: Universität Basel (Departement Geschichte) and Universität Graz (ZIM-ACDH); edited by Susanna Burghartz
notes: Jahrrechnungen der Stadt Basel 1535-1610: a digital edition of the annual city accounts of Basel, 76 objects (one per year from 1535/36 to 1609/10; 1584/85 is missing), from the Staatsarchiv Basel-Stadt (series Finanz H). Edited by Susanna Burghartz with Sonia Calvi, Lukas Meili, Jonas Sagelsdorff and Georg Vogeler; part of DEPCHA (Digital Edition Publishing Cooperative for Historical Accounts), hosted on GAMS at the University of Graz (ZIM-ACDH) with the Mellon-funded DEPCHA partners. Each year is published as an HTML edition with TEI-XML and RDF, and bulk downloads of all TEI and RDF files are offered; objects are dated 30 March 2023. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
